pages.title: Block of Cherenkov Quartz
pages.text: Nine pieces of Cherenkov quartz fused into a single block that glows the soft blue of particles outrunning light in a medium. It is cool, translucent and slightly brighter in the dark than any ordinary stone should be.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compacting Cherenkov quartz made storage easier and, as a bonus, the larger crystal glowed more strongly. I started building with it before I had a reason to.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cherenkov Lamp, Cherenkov Quartz, Neutrino Condenser, Photonic Lens, Proton Decay Residue, Pulsar Timing Crystal, Structure Assembler, Tachyon Resonator.
